New Two-Wheelers Launched in India

Hero MotoCorp has launched the New Passion+ Disc, a motorcycle featuring smart features and a reported mileage of 71 kmpl. Concurrently, Honda has introduced its new maxi-scooter, the Vario EVO 160. These launches expand the offerings in the Indian two-wheeler market, providing consumers with new options in both motorcycle and scooter segments.
